description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single hybrid ranged attacks (0.60 or 1.50 each), grants [ATK, DEF and MAG +30% (25s)] to all allies, grants [Attach Wind 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Smooth Sailing!] to the user

description.name: Vacuum Cutter
description.text: Six single ranged hybrid attacks (0.90 or 3.05 each)

description.name: Wind Booster
description.text: Three single ranged hybrid attacks (0.80 or 2.70 each), causes [Imperil Wind 10% (15s)] every two activations, grants [Buff Wind 10% (15s)] to the user every two activations

description.name: Attach Wind 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Smooth Sailing!
description.text: Grants [Wind Ability +30% Boost 1] to all allies after using two of Vacuum Cutter or Wind Booster

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands
